```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(here)
library(tabularaster)
devtools::install_github("isciences/exactextractr")
library(exactextractr)
library(tmap)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```


# Load data

## Coral reefs

```{r}
reefs<-st_read(here("projected_data/Allen_Coral_Atlas/coral_algae_proj.shp"))
```


## Plumes

These currently don't have the wave/current information added, just decay function

```{r}
plume_files<-list.files(here("output_data/Plumes"), full.names = T)

r1<-raster(plume_files[1])

r1p<-projectRaster(r1, crs = t_crs)
r2p<-projectRaster(r2, crs = t_crs)
r3p<-projectRaster(r3, crs = t_crs)

all_rp<-merge(r1p,r2p,r3p)

merge_rasters(
  plume_files,
  output_raster = here("output_data/Plumes/Merged_plumes.tif"),
  options = character(0),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  force_fallback = FALSE
)

r<-raster(here("output_data/Plumes/Merged_plumes.tif"))
rp<-projectRaster(r, crs = t_crs)
```

# Intersect coral reefs with plumes and calculates the amount of nutrients

```{r}
  n_reefs<-exactextractr::exact_extract(rp, reefs, fun = "sum")
  n_df<-as.data.frame(n_reefs)
  done<-cbind(reefs, n_df)

st_write(done, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Nitrogen_on_reefs.shp"), delete_layer = TRUE)
```
```{r}
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(done) +
    tm_polygons("n_reefs")
```
